# Garaga

> > Garaga is a leading garage door manufacturer providing comprehensive resources on residential garage door installation, maintenance, security, and smart home integration with LiftMaster and MyQ technology.

The site offers expert guidance for homeowners on garage door selection, safety, preventive maintenance, and modern smart opener systems. Garaga specializes in residential garage doors with a focus on quality construction, security features, and integration with LiftMaster Elite Series openers and MyQ connectivity.

- [The Most Common Garage Door Injury to Children Is Also the Most Preventable](https://www.garaga.com/ca/blog/the-most-common-garage-door-injury-to-children-is-also-the-most-preventable): Child finger injury prevention tips & electric eye sensor safety measures
- [Do You Recognize the Signs of An Unbalanced Garage Door?](https://www.garaga.com/ca/blog/do-you-recognize-the-warning-signs-of-an-unbalanced-garage-door): Warning signs & safety risks of unbalanced garage doors & torsion springs
- [Staying Safe Around Automatic Garage Doors](https://www.garaga.com/blog/staying-safe-around-automatic-garage-doors): Safety tips & accident prevention for automatic garage door operation
